claims.claim: Resize RGB to 224 by 224 with bilinear interpolation; ImageNet channel normalisation; training flip, rotation and brightness/contrast jitter; no crop.
claims.evidence: One official image was read and resized; augmentation and full-cohort preprocessing have not been verified.

claims.claim: Patient-level split; manuscript reports 3231, 808, and 1346 images.
claims.evidence: Official archive filename matching links 643 patients across the all-image source partitions and 344 across the clean partitions; counts also differ from manuscript. Preparation rejects leakage and requires an externally verified patient assignment.

claims.claim: Six clinical fields sampled from database-derived joint distributions and translated into five languages.
claims.evidence: Preparation requires externally supplied image-level text. Manuscript joint distributions, translations and image-profile assignments are unavailable.

claims.claim: HCC versus all others; external test cohorts held out.
claims.evidence: The manuscript selection, TCIA DICOM instances, and Chulabhorn files were not available.

claims.claim: DINOv2 ViT-B/14 yields 256 patch tokens of width 768 at 224 resolution.
claims.evidence: Backbone must be supplied externally; real pretrained backbone has not been loaded.

claims.claim: Two linear layers with GELU project image tokens; visual tokens precede text tokens.
claims.evidence: Full pretrained backbones have not been validated; projection hidden width is unspecified in the manuscript.

claims.claim: A linear head maps the last text position to a binary logit.
claims.evidence: The full language backbone has not been validated; the caller must supply EOS in each text.

claims.claim: 20 epochs, masked image modelling at 75 percent; AdamW lr 1e-5, batch 64, weight decay .05, cosine schedule.
claims.evidence: Reconstruction target, decoder and complete source pool not specified; not implemented.

claims.claim: Five epochs, frozen vision and language, train projection with next-token loss, AdamW lr .001 and batch 32.
claims.evidence: Parameter configuration available; no stage-two loop or complete optimizer settings were verified.

claims.claim: Ten epochs; LoRA rank 64, alpha 128, dropout .05 for query and value; BCE and next-token losses weighted .7/.3.
claims.evidence: Full schedule, distributed execution and pretrained model have not been verified. Language and classifier learning rates must be supplied because the manuscript omits them.

claims.claim: Manuscript says all 32 language layers.
claims.evidence: Official Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model card states 28 layers. The adapter traverses the actual model layers.

claims.claim: Stage 3 AdamW beta .9/.95, weight decay .1, gradient clipping 1.0, 3 percent warmup and cosine floor 1e-7.
claims.evidence: Optimizer and gradient clipping implemented; scheduler, accumulation, precision and distributed execution not implemented.

claims.claim: Five runs with seeds 42, 137, 256, 1024, 2048.
claims.evidence: RNG state and seed are saved and restored; five full runs not performed.

claims.claim: AUROC; sensitivity at 90 percent specificity; specificity at 90 percent sensitivity; Youden threshold.
claims.evidence: Clinical operating points have not been verified on the paper data.

claims.claim: PPV and NPV at assumed 5 percent prevalence.
claims.evidence: No cohort estimates have been calculated.

claims.claim: Ten-bin expected calibration error and Brier score.
claims.evidence: Calibration has not been verified on cohort data.

claims.claim: Net benefit TP/N minus FP/N multiplied by threshold odds.
claims.evidence: No patient-level decision curve has been computed.

claims.claim: Confidence intervals, DeLong, Holm correction, McNemar and other subgroup statistics.
claims.evidence: Not implemented; predictions and paired cohort data absent.

claims.claim: Baseline comparisons, multilingual, clinical field, hyperparameter, subgroup and quantization experiments.
claims.evidence: No baselines, trained weights or experimental cohort files provided.

claims.claim: Manuscript identifies Figshare DOI ending 29755535.
claims.evidence: Both official Figshare records identify SMC-LUD and advertise files with the same size and supplied MD5; byte-for-byte comparison of complete downloads was not performed.
